subject: Coord: Multi-cloud co-sell demo — primary + contingency slots
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@logisys.com>, Anna Li <anna-li@amazon.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed multi-cloud demo windows + contingency plan

Hi Carlos / Anna —

Thanks for agreeing to coordinate a joint demo that shows Redwood + LogiSys running on both AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace (brief 30–40 minute technical + business overview, followed by Q&A). We have a small set of customers in EMEA that want to evaluate multi-cloud deployment patterns, and showcasing both marketplace flows will help the procurement questions.

Primary ask: can we lock a 45-minute slot next week that works for LogiSys (Lisbon) + AWS rep + our SEs? Below are preferred windows (Ben in PST, Carlos in WEST/EU):
- Option A: Tue 11 May — 09:00 PDT / 17:00 WEST (preferred by LogiSys)
- Option B: Wed 12 May — 07:30 PDT / 15:30 WEST (earlier for our SEs)

Important: we expect heavy cross-cloud discussion; please confirm if Anna (AWS Marketplace) can join as an observer and whether we should loop in GCP marketplace contacts. If attendance is tight, we want an explicit contingency slot and a fallback runbook (shorter demo + recorded snippet to show Marketplace procurement steps). I attached a draft agenda and an availability ics with buffered slots to avoid timezone overlaps.

Next steps: if you share a hard no for any of the options, I’ll propose alternates and flag a contingency slot at the end of the week.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-logisys-demo-agenda-v1.pdf, slot-rollup-availability.ics
From: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@logisys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Li <anna-li@amazon.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 00:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposed multi-cloud demo windows + contingency plan

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the options. Option A (Tue 11 May 17:00 WEST) works best for our lead architects in Lisbon. One request: can we shift the start by 15 minutes to 17:15 so our pre-call runbook finishes? Also, on attendance, GCP marketplace should be looped in — I’ll forward to our GCP contact, but Anna please confirm your availability (even as observer) so we can keep AWS procurement questions inline.

I can share a brief pre-demo doc on LogiSys integration patterns if helpful.

—Carlos
Carlos Mendes
Head of Partnerships, LogiSys
carlos.mendes@logisys.com

Thanks everyone — locked: Tue 11 May 2027, 17:15 WEST / 09:15 PDT (45 minutes).

Quick operational notes (please skim):
- Agenda attached (redwood-logisys-demo-agenda-v1.pdf). Plan: 15 min tech walkthrough (LogiSys + Redwood), 20 min Marketplace procurement flows + live demo of listing process, 10 min Q&A.
- Contingency: If Marketplace rep cannot join live, we’ll record the procurement segment and annotate the recording with time-stamped notes and links to the marketplace listing proof points.
- Backup slot: Thu 13 May 14:00 WEST / 06:00 PDT (15-min contingency window) — only to be used if Tuesday needs to be cut short.
- Calendar invite updated with buffered prep time (15 min buffer before start). Please accept the ICS.

Kimberly / Sergio: can you confirm SE roles on the call (Kimberly — lead demo; Sergio — infra Qs)? I’ll do the procurement runway and kickoff.

Ben
